# Upload documents to a dispute case

Upload documents, such as a police report or screenshots, so Swan's investigators receive them with the case.
Documents are optional.
Upload them before you submit. After submission, send them through the support ticket.

:::tip Prerequisites
- The case is a `Draft`.
- You have the case's supporting document collection ID, returned when you [created the case](./guide-create-fraud.mdx).
:::

## Guide {#guide}

1. Call the `generateSupportingDocumentUploadUrl` mutation.
1. Add the `supportingDocumentCollectionId` and `filename` (lines 4-5).
1. Add a `supportingDocumentPurpose` (line 6). For fraud dispute cases, see the [accepted purposes](./index.mdx#fraud-details).
1. Add the success payload with the `fields` and `url` (lines 11-16).
1. Upload the file to the `url`, as described in [Upload an onboarding document](/topics/accounts/documents/guide-upload-onboarding#guide-recover-url). The request is the same.

## Mutation {#mutation}

<a href="https://explorer.swan.io?%3D&tab=api" className="explorer-badge">Open in API Explorer</a>

```graphql {4-6,11,16} showLineNumbers
mutation UploadDisputeCaseDocument {
  generateSupportingDocumentUploadUrl(
    input: {
      supportingDocumentCollectionId: "$COLLECTION_ID"
      filename: "police-report.pdf"
      supportingDocumentPurpose: PoliceReport
    }
  ) {
    ... on GenerateSupportingDocumentUploadUrlSuccessPayload {
      __typename
      upload {
        fields {
          key
          value
        }
        url
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Payload {#payload}

The payload includes the `url` (line 12) and several `key`/`value` pairs (only one is shown) to send with the file.

```json title="Payload" {12} showLineNumbers
{
  "data": {
    "generateSupportingDocumentUploadUrl": {
      "__typename": "GenerateSupportingDocumentUploadUrlSuccessPayload",
      "upload": {
        "fields": [
          {
            "key": "Key",
            "value": "INPUT/$DOCUMENT_ID"
          }
        ],
        "url": "$UPLOAD_URL"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

When you submit the case, the collection moves to `PendingReview` automatically.
